statements.sql:
SELECT TABLE_NAME
                    FROM "{catalog}".INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
                    WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ?
DESCRIBE TABLE "{catalog}"."{schema}"."buys"
SELECT "buy_id", "user_id", "item_id", "ts" FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."buys" LIMIT 1000
DESCRIBE TABLE "{catalog}"."{schema}"."items"
SELECT "item_id", "kind" FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."items" LIMIT 1000
DESCRIBE TABLE "{catalog}"."{schema}"."orders"
SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "price", "ts" FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."orders" LIMIT 1000
DESCRIBE TABLE "{catalog}"."{schema}"."users"
SELECT "user_id", "age", "country" FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."users" LIMIT 1000
SHOW IMPORTED KEYS IN TABLE "{catalog}"."{schema}"."buys"
SHOW IMPORTED KEYS IN TABLE "{catalog}"."{schema}"."items"
SHOW IMPORTED KEYS IN TABLE "{catalog}"."{schema}"."orders"
SHOW IMPORTED KEYS IN TABLE "{catalog}"."{schema}"."users"

SELECT 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "buy_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "buy_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."buys"
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "item_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "item_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."items"
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "order_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "order_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."orders"
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "user_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "user_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."users"
SHOW TABLES LIKE ? IN SCHEMA "{catalog}"."{schema}"
SHOW TABLES LIKE ? IN SCHEMA "{catalog}"."{schema}"
SHOW TABLES LIKE ? IN SCHEMA "{catalog}"."{schema}"
SHOW TABLES LIKE ? IN SCHEMA "{catalog}"."{schema}"

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN("ts") as min_date,
  MAX("ts") as max_date
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."buys"

SELECT "user_id"
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."users"
SAMPLE ROW (10000 ROWS)
WHERE "user_id" IS NOT NULL

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value[0]::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__,
    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "item_id", "ts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."buys"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE "ts" <= ?
AND "ts" > ?
